name: AI Content Advisor
description: Analyzes content with AI and returns improvement recommendations (SEO, readability, etc.).
project_description:
The AI Content Advisor is a flexible Drupal module that extends and enhances the capabilities of the AI SEO Analyzer project. Built on the foundation of AI SEO, this module provides a comprehensive content analysis framework that goes far beyond SEO optimization to support diverse content evaluation needs across your Drupal site.

 Back to top 

 Overview 
 This module integrates seamlessly with Drupal's AI ecosystem to deliver intelligent, AI-powered content analysis directly within your content management workflow. While it includes several pre-configured SEO analysis templates based on the original AI SEO project, the AI Content Advisor is designed as a versatile platform for any type of content analysis and advisory services.

 Back to top 

 Key Features 
 Configurable Analysis Types 
 
 Multiple Report Configurations : Unlike the original AI SEO module, AI Content Advisor supports configurable report types, allowing you to create custom analysis templates for different content evaluation purposes 
 Pre-built SEO Templates : Includes ready-to-use SEO analysis configurations covering all areas from the original AI SEO project 
 Custom Analysis Creation : Build your own content analysis workflows for accessibility audits, content quality reviews, brand compliance checks, readability assessments, and more 
 
 Enhanced Content Analysis 
 
 Comprehensive SEO Analysis : All original AI SEO features including Topic Authority, Meta Tags, Headings Structure, Content Analysis, Image Optimization, Link Analysis, and more 
 Extended Use Cases : Perfect for content quality assurance, editorial reviews, compliance checking, accessibility auditing, and brand guideline validation 
 Historical Reporting : All generated reports are stored for future reference and comparison 
 
 Flexible Configuration 
 
 Customizable Prompts : Modify analysis prompts to match your specific content requirements 
 Targeted Analysis Areas : Focus on specific aspects of your content with detailed, configurable analysis zones 
 Content Moderation Integration : Analyze draft revisions alongside published content 
 Permission Controls : Granular access control for different user roles 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation & Setup 
 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10.3+ or 11.x 
 AI module (required dependency) 
 Configured AI provider (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) 
 
 Post-Installation Configuration 
 
 Configure your AI provider at /admin/config/ai/providers 
 Set up AI Content Advisor at /admin/config/ai/content-advisor 
 Configure AI Content Advisor report types at /admin/config/ai-content-advisor/report-types 
 Set appropriate user permissions at /admin/people/permissions/module/ai_content_advisor 
 Access content analysis from the node view tabs or content management interfaces 
 
 Back to top 

 Use Cases 
 SEO Optimization 
 
 Complete SEO analysis with all features from the original AI SEO project 
 Technical SEO auditing and recommendations 
 Content optimization suggestions 
 
 Content Quality Assurance 
 
 Editorial review assistance 
 Content structure and readability analysis 
 Brand voice and tone compliance checking 
 
 Accessibility & Compliance 
 
 Accessibility audit workflows 
 Regulatory compliance content review 
 Industry-specific content standards validation 
 
 Editorial Workflows 
 
 Content performance analysis 
 Multi-language content consistency checks 
 Publication readiness assessments 
 
 Back to top 

 Relationship to AI SEO 
 This project is built upon the solid foundation of the AI SEO Analyzer module, incorporating all of its core SEO analysis capabilities while expanding the framework to support broader content analysis needs. Users migrating from AI SEO will find familiar functionality plus enhanced configurability and extended use cases.

 We strongly encourage all current users of AI SEO Analyzer to switch to AI Content Advisor. This module provides everything that AI SEO offers plus:

 
 Configurable report types and analysis templates
